about.description: Nimbalyst is the visual workspace for building with Codex and Claude Code.
about.feature_editors: Agentic WYSIWYG visual editors for markdown, mockups, Excalidraw, Mermaid, data models, CSV and code, with extensions.
about.feature_sessions: Parallel session management and kanban to understand session state, search and resume sessions, and link sessions to files and files to sessions.
about.feature_tracking: Item tracking and kanban to manage plans, bugs, and tasks with your agent.
about.feature_storage: Open storage of content and status in plain files on disk and Git.
